newsitem.title: GERMANY: German railway eyes expanding into utilities area.
newsitem.headline: German railway eyes expanding into utilities area.

text.p: German railway Deutsche Bahn AG plans to enter the utilities sector and is looking for a business partner, a German newspaper reported at the weekend.

In a summary of an article to appear in Sunday's edition of Die Welt, the newspaper said Deutsche Bahn plans to create a subsidiary called DB-Energieversorgungs GmbH on January 1 and offer services to electricity suppliers.
Heinz Duerr, head of Deutsche Bahn, said talks with potential partners were under way but he declined to give names.
The railway already has a similar telecommunications joint venture with Mannesmann.
